notes: Every Bundestag and Bundesrat procedure - bills, Bundesrat resolutions, written and minor questions with the government's answers, EU documents forwarded to parliament - stored by `run.py collect-dip`, not crawled. Every type except the procedural ones above (seats, elections, standing orders, immunity, discharge: 392 of 9,382 records over 90 days). Bills alone would have missed every relevant item found in the 2026-09-11 probe. Record dates are the latest step, not adoption; aktualisiert is a re-indexing stamp. See src/dip.py and docs/source_coverage.md, 'Parliament'.

Every EU legislative procedure since since_year, stored by `run.py collect-ep` from the EP Open Data API, not crawled. Measured 2026-09-11: 609 procedures since 2021, 217 still open, about 3 MB for the open set and a few MB a year of changes. Resolutions (RSP) and own-initiative reports (INI) are out until a report shows the need. It began as a hand-picked list of 14 files for J&T, which made collection client-specific; what that list knew is now clients/jt-express/labels/ep_procedures_2026-09-11.json, an expectation checked against the gate. keyword_prefilter is off because the set is small and titles such as 'Clean corporate vehicles' match no profile keyword, so every procedure goes to the body gate. The API rate-limits without warning: pacing, backoff and a stop-and-resume rule are in src/ep_procedures.py. See docs/source_coverage.md, 'Parliament'.
